styleguideGame.body: Short lessons with a guide voice. Your notes light up as you hit them.

styleguideGame.buttonsHelp: Square, in pixel type, with a hard shadow that a press sinks into. Press one to see it.
styleguideGame.gemsHelp: The note gems are the only glass. Bars are flat blocks.
styleguideGame.coinsHelp: Game mode's circles are arcade coins (Hillel's pick, 2026-11-08): a flat round in its colour, a dark edge, a hard light at the top and shade at the foot, and a cabinet button's solid depth under it. Done in its colour, the one you're on in the accent with its ring, the next an empty slot, the challenge a diamond.
styleguideGame.libraryHelp: A band's title in its tone, songs as cartridges (a hover lifts one and a cursor blinks), their tags in tones, and rows in a frame with player slots. Scanlines have their own switch in Settings.

styleguide.bubblesLine: Serious mode's circles that stand for a thing: a lesson on a path, a done day, a person, a disc to press. Lit above the icon, so the icon keeps its contrast.
styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.intro: Every token and component of forms and the admin, in every state. Build new screens from these.
styleguide.body: Body text sits at a comfortable measure, with room between lines, so longer explanations stay easy to read on a phone.
styleguide.fieldTitleHelp: As it appears in the library.
styleguide.fieldEmailError: That doesn't look like an email address. Check it and try again.

styleguide.sheetBody: A bottom sheet on phones, a centred card from tablet up.
styleguide.emptyBody: New takes show here as singers send them.
styleguide.fieldSelectLong: A dropdown with a long choice

styleguide.fieldSelectHelp: Every dropdown has the same chevron, and a long choice stops before it.
styleguide.fieldSelectDisabled: A dropdown that can't change now
styleguide.confirmHelp: Confirmations name the thing and what happens to it, put the action on its own button (never OK), and offer "Don't ask again" only when there's an Undo. Never the browser's own dialogs.
styleguide.confirmBody: It goes from this device, with its 3 parts. You can undo it straight after.
styleguide.buttonsHelp: Primary says do this; secondary is a soft tint, never an outline; ghost is words alone; danger only on the final confirm of something that can't be undone. Disabled always comes with a line saying why.
styleguide.controlsHelp: Chosen is the accent colour, with a small lift. Every control is 44px tall or keeps a 44px target, and the arrow keys move a segmented choice.

oneFourFive.name: Home and back
oneFourFive.feel: The plainest, strongest song shape there is.

oneFourOneFive.name: Call and answer
oneFourOneFive.feel: Steps out, comes home, then leaves the door open.

oneFiveOne.name: Two chords
oneFiveOne.feel: Home and away, like a folk song or a lullaby.

fourChords.name: The four chords
fourChords.feel: The sound of a thousand pop songs: bright and singable.

sadFour.name: The four chords, wistful
sadFour.feel: The same four, starting on the minor one: tender.

dooWop.name: Doo-wop
dooWop.feel: The fifties street-corner sound, made for voices.

oneFourSixFive.name: Hopeful pop
oneFourSixFive.feel: Climbs and leans forward into the next line.

fourOneFiveSix.name: Lift-off
fourOneFiveSix.feel: Starts away from home, so it soars: a chorus favourite.

minorFourAche.name: The bittersweet turn
minorFourAche.feel: A major chord turns minor: a lovely ache.

gospel.name: Gospel
gospel.feel: Leans into the four chord, then sighs into its minor, like a church choir.

twoFiveOne.name: The jazz cadence
twoFiveOne.feel: Smooth and inevitable, the way standards land.

turnaround.name: The turnaround
turnaround.feel: Spins round and round for swinging close harmony.

andalusian.name: Flamenco steps
andalusian.feel: Walks down step by step: dramatic and dark.

epicMinor.name: Epic minor
epicMinor.feel: Big, open and a little heroic.

minorHome.name: Minor home
minorHome.feel: A plain minor song shape, with a strong pull home.

minorLift.name: Minor, rising
minorLift.feel: Minor, but lifting towards the light.

canon.name: The Canon
canon.feel: Pachelbel's famous walk: graceful and classical.

circle.name: Round the circle
circle.feel: Each chord pulls to the next, all the way home.

mixolydian.name: Folk rock
mixolydian.feel: A chord borrowed from just below home gives it an open, Celtic air.

dorianVamp.name: Dorian groove
dorianVamp.feel: Two chords rocking gently: minor with a bright side.

risingMinor.name: Rising to minor
risingMinor.feel: Climbs two steps up into home: a minor chorus that soars.

minorPlea.name: Minor plea
minorPlea.feel: Starts away from home and circles round, longing.

minorSway.name: Minor sway
minorSway.feel: Rocks between home and the chords below it: moody and big.

minorBright.name: Minor, sunlit
minorBright.feel: A minor song with a bright major four: Dorian sunshine.

royalRoad.name: The royal road
royalRoad.feel: Soars from the four chord: a chorus that takes off.

climb.name: The climb
climb.feel: Four, five, then home at the top: a big landing.

party.name: Party loop
party.feel: Three chords round and round: hands in the air.

barbershop.name: Barbershop
barbershop.feel: The ringing chain of sevenths barbershop quartets love.

why.lift: Starts somewhere brighter, so it lifts off the verse.
why.contrast: Changes colour and pace, so the chorus stands apart.
why.classic: A pairing songwriters often reach for.
why.bridgeFour: Leans away to the four chord, then builds to the five.
why.bridgeMinor: A minor detour before the last chorus.
why.bridgeFlatSeven: A surprising chord from below home, then back toward the chorus.
why.bridgeMinorFour: A bittersweet minor four, then back.
why.bridgeRelative: Opens into the relative major, then turns back.
why.bridgeSixth: Floats up through the sixth and seventh.
why.bridgeTwo: Steps sideways to the two chord, gentle and searching.
why.bridgeThree: Drifts through the minor three and six before turning toward home.
why.prechorus: Builds up to the chorus, so it lands with a lift.
why.bridgeBlues: The rhythm and blues bridge: four, home, four, then five.

refused.today: You can claim six a day. Try again tomorrow.
refused.taken: Someone else just claimed that one.
refused.notVolunteer: Agree to the Lend your voice agreement first.
refused.blocked: You can't lend your voice any more: a take or a voice of yours was taken down for abuse. Write to us if you think that's a mistake.

reasons.personal: It's someone recorded without their OK, or private information

report.failed: The report didn't send. Try again.
